changes.summary: Added role check in normalizeCodexRolloutMessage so system and developer role messages are hidden before they enter chat, counts, or titles.
Regression coverage for role-filtering, title fallback, and bootstrap false-positive guard.
Narrowed AGENTS.md, <INSTRUCTIONS>, and MCP bootstrap patterns so legitimate user prompts mentioning MCP, <INSTRUCTIONS>, or AGENTS remain visible unless they match actual injected bootstrap shapes.
Negative regression assertions for legitimate MCP, <INSTRUCTIONS>, and AGENTS prompts.

Removed generic MCP bootstrap filters ([MCP], /^MCP server started/, /^MCP startup diagnostic/) so user prompts containing [MCP] and 'MCP server started but...' remain visible. Narrowed 'You are...' patterns from generic /You are (powered by|an AI)/ to exact injected forms /^You are powered by the model named/ and /^You are an AI assistant (accessed via an API|.)/. Anchor remaining tag patterns to start-of-string.

Replaced overly broad positive assertions with exact-form matches. Added prompt-preservation regression guards: 'What does [MCP] mean in this error?', 'MCP server started but my tool still cannot connect', 'Why does the prompt say You are an AI assistant?' all return false.
